dict.Ce e depășit iese în roșu, ce vine în 14: Overdue items show in red, those due within 14 days in yellow; after the work is done, enter the new date under “Last service”.
dict.De exemplu: revizia stivuitorului la 180: For example: forklift service every 180 days, pressure-equipment inspection every 365, scale calibration check every 365 (see the machine’s technical manual).
dict.Stivuitoarele, cântarele, compresoarele: Forklifts, scales, compressors and other machines, with every recurring task (service, pressure-equipment or calibration inspection, oil change): from the last service and the interval in days you get the next date and the days left; overdue ones show in red, those due in the next 14 days in yellow, and on the right the cost of the services.
dict.Un rând pe fiecare lucrare care se repet: One row per recurring task: the machine, the task, the date of the last service and how many days apart it is done.
